verification.word_id_source: November 2025 HSK 3.0 examination syllabus, cumulative official IDs 2001–3600 (numbered homograph headwords preserved).
verification.gloss_source: Initial English glosses from existing Level5 data, with additional 1.0.1 manual corrections. Glosses are editorial drafts pending independent item-by-item verification.
verification.sentence_policy: All 1,600 entries have two individually authored or previously curated contextual sentences. The 1,378 defective generic-template entry pairs have been replaced. Independent native-speaker certification remains outstanding.
verification.pinyin_policy: Sentence pinyin was recomputed mechanically using the cumulative HSK 1–5 lexicon, longest-match heuristic and ICU fallback; polyphony, sandhi, punctuation and word boundaries still need item-level verification.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_policy: Target cumulative HSK 1–5 IDs 1–3600; example vocabulary boundary and word-level segmentation are not independently certified.
verification.taxonomy_policy: Identical hsk3_topics.json v2.0.0: 22 parent topics and 25 subtopics. No new categories, no changes to Levels 1–4.
verification.review_limitations: All generic POS-based sentence frames have been replaced, but this is NOT a native-speaker proofread, corpus attestation, strict level-bounded vocabulary audit, formal-register certification or complete gloss-by-gloss verification.
